synthesis.problem: On the Scout admin org map, choosing the 7 Days date filter makes the Live Hits Pending Repossession list look like it only covers today. Scrolling the list never reaches a row dated before today. Yesterday works. The control is not resetting — the result set is truncated.
synthesis.outcome: Selecting 7 / 15 / 30 / 60 Days returns pending hits across the full window (newest first). Scrolling can reach pre-today rows when they exist. Same behavior on admin org map and Scout driver map. Root cause named and pinned by a regression test.

scope.summary: BirdsEye recentHits still has the old hard →limit(20) the driver already removed (95da4d7f). For a busy org, the newest 20 open plates are all from today, so a multi-day range looks like 'today only' with no pagination to go further.
